{{Quote|Bib wants you to talk to Dunir about doing a delivery for him.|[[Niko Brehe]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find Dunir|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Dunir Signos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was employed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|How'd you like to make some fast credits?|Dunir Signos, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SD" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dunir met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was indebted to Jabba. The spacer was sent to Dunir by [[Niko Brehe]] in an effort to help pay off their debt to Jabba,<ref name="SWG:FD" /> and so Dunir tasked the spacer with delivering a package to [[Toggi Bok]], who had a camp just outside of Mos Eisley. Once the spacer had completed this task, Dunir sent them to the nearby [[White Thranta Shipping Company]] [[White Thranta Shipping offices|offices]] just outside Mos Eisley to retrieve a package that belonged to Jabba. The spacer spoke with the receptionist, requesting the package, which the receptionist quickly found and delivered to the spacer. The spacer returned the package to Dunir, who then sent them off to [[Reimos Taligg]] to continue squaring away their debts with Jabba.<ref name="SWG:SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dunir Signos appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dunir Signos was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
